# Setup

```{r Setup}
# Clear environment
rm(list=ls())

#use to set working directory 
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir="~/GitHub/MIMICS-CN-for-publication/Sensitivity_Analysis_CF/")
```

```{r Load packages}
require("tidyverse")
```

```{r Load data}
# Original model outputs:
outputs_orig <- read.csv("./data/MIMICS_SSoutput_ORIGINAL.csv")

# Model outputs with 100x lignin input for CWT:
outputs_Lig <- read.csv("./data/MIMICS_SSoutput_Lignin_Test_OE_20261022.csv")

# Model outputs with 100x ANPP input for CWT:
outputs_ANPP <- read.csv("./data/MIMICS_SSoutput_ANPP_Test_CF_20261022.csv")

# Model outputs with 2x lignin input for CWT:
outputs_Lig_2x <- read.csv("./data/MIMICS_SSoutput_Ligg_2x.csv")

# Model outputs with 2x ANPP input for CWT:
outputs_ANPP_2x <- read.csv("./data/MIMICS_SSoutput_ANPP_2x.csv")
```

```{r}
vars <- c("SOMp","SOMc","SOMa","Resp")

comb <- bind_rows(
  mutate(outputs_orig, Scenario = "Original"),
  mutate(outputs_Lig,  Scenario = "Lignin x100"),
  mutate(outputs_ANPP, Scenario = "ANPP x100")) |>
  select(Site, Scenario, all_of(vars)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to = "Variable") |>
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, vars))

change <- comb |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value) |>
  pivot_longer(c(`Lignin x100`, `ANPP x100`), names_to = "Scenario", values_to = "new") |>
  mutate(pct_change = 100 * (new - Original) / Original,
         Scenario = factor(Scenario, c("Lignin x100", "ANPP x100")))

# Fig 1: raw values at CWT
cwt <- comb |> filter(Site == "CWT") |>
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, c("Original", "Lignin x100", "ANPP x100")))
ggplot(cwt, aes(Scenario, value, fill = Scenario)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "CWT outputs under adjusted inputs", y = "Model output", x = NULL)

# Fig 2: percent change at CWT
ggplot(filter(change, Site == "CWT"), aes(Scenario, pct_change, fill = Scenario)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.0f%%", pct_change),
                vjust = ifelse(pct_change >= 0, -0.3, 1.2))) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  labs(title = "Percent change from original at CWT", y = "% change", x = NULL)
```
